C1.worst_defect: Lede explains the product as 'open-source till for Vendure, the open-source headless commerce framework' — the owner has to get past 'headless commerce framework' before reading 'keeps selling when the connection drops'; on phone the header shows only Docs and Live demo, with Quick start / At the till hidden behind the chevron

C2.worst_defect: 'Live demo or your own store' row 'Refund a sale at the till': demo 'Yes', own store 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0 ... stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls' — honest, but in developer terms; it never says what the customer gets back or when, and the demo trains staff on a refund button their store will not have
C2.where: home.desktop.02 / home.phone.04 table; at-the-till 'Refund a sale'

C3.worst_defect: Device key path has a known hole: the role made by 'New POS till key' has no ReadOrder on 0.3.0, so 'the till's order history is refused until you add it to the role' by hand; scanning also needs a 'barcode' ProductVariant custom field plus a database migration before the scanner works
C3.where: quick-start 'Optional: a device key' and step 8c; changelog 0.2.0 last bullet; connect-a-till 'Enter your store details'

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting mixes cashier-facing header notices with admin GraphQL (tallyNeedsAdminCommands / tallyResolveNeedsAdmin, SuperAdmin, VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP) on one page; At the till is a long reference with no short 'first shift' checklist a cashier can follow

C5.worst_defect: Cashier sheet and register closure screenshots sit in oversized framed boxes with large empty padding around small images; the feature list under the two home cards is undifferentiated plain text

C6.worst_defect: At the till runs to 9 phone screens (~9000 px) with no jump list at top of body; inline code chips such as `N orders waiting to send` break onto their own lines inside the 'If the internet drops' callout

C7.worst_defect: og-image crops the till screenshot at its bottom edge; 404 page body has no search box or structured data; Lighthouse flags 53 KiB unused JS and 14 KiB legacy JS on /

overall_worst.defect: On a real store (plugin 0.3.0) a refund cannot be done at the till, and the site explains it as an administrator settling it 'with two Admin API calls' while the live demo refunds at the till — an owner cannot tell how a customer refund works day to day or what the customer is told
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store' row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till 'Refund a sale'
overall_worst.fix: In the home row and At the till › Refund a sale, say in plain words who does the refund, where (Vendure Dashboard), and when the customer's money actually goes back; mark the demo's refund-at-till as 'demo only, not on 0.3.0 stores'; link Plugin setup for the developer steps instead of naming API calls
